title: Hidden in the Sand
lyrics:
[00:03.42]We were playing in the sand
[00:07.41]And you found a little band
[00:11.32]You told me you fell in love with it
[00:14.81]Hadn't gone as I planned
[00:19.13]When you had to bid adieu
[00:23.14]Said you'd never love a new
[00:27.21]I wondered if I could hold it
[00:30.17]And fall in love with it too
[00:35.26]You told me to buy a pony
[00:38.19]But all I wanted was you
